prompt:
You write realistic customer-support tickets for testing a ticket router.

Two intents the router must tell apart:
A = data_breach_concern: worries that their data was leaked
B = privacy_complaint: complains about how their personal data is used

Write 2 tickets for each level below (10 tickets in all), each 1-3 sentences, in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never name the intents or use their exact wording.
- clear_a: plainly A, not B.
- lean_a: mostly A, with some features of B.
- even: genuinely ambiguous between A and B; a careful person could not tell which.
- lean_b: mostly B, with some features of A.
- clear_b: plainly B, not A.

Answer with JSON only: {"tickets": [{"level": "clear_a", "text": "..."}, ...]}

message.content: {"tickets":[{"level":"clear_a","text":"I got a password-reset email for an account I didn’t try to access, and support says there was a sign-in from another country. Can you check whether someone got into my account details?"},{"level":"clear_a","text":"A caller knew the address and phone number I used only on your site, and I’ve also seen unfamiliar login alerts. I’m worried someone may have gotten hold of my customer records."},{"level":"lean_a","text":"I signed up for your service last week, and now I’m getting convincing messages that use the same details I gave you. I don’t know if someone saw my information or if it’s being shared with marketing partners, but I want to know how it got out."},{"level":"lean_a","text":"My account page showed a device I don’t recognize, and afterward I started receiving ads tied to a health issue I searched for in your app. Did someone access my profile, or is the app using those details to target me?"},{"level":"even","text":"I keep getting calls that seem connected to things I’ve entered in your app, and I can’t tell whether that’s because another company has seen the information or because your systems are putting it to use. Could you explain what’s going on?"},{"level":"even","text":"A few details I shared with your service have started showing up in places I didn’t expect. I’m not sure whether someone outside your company got them or whether they’re being used in a way I never agreed to."},{"level":"lean_b","text":"Why am I seeing ads based on private notes I saved in your app? It feels like those details are being passed around, and I’d like to know who can see them."},{"level":"lean_b","text":"I gave your service my location so it could provide directions, not so it could build a profile of where I go. I’ve also noticed unfamiliar activity on my account, so please tell me what’s being done with that location history."},{"level":"clear_b","text":"I’m uncomfortable that your app uses my purchase history to personalize offers, especially since I never opted into that. Please turn off that kind of targeting and tell me how to remove the profile you’ve built."},{"level":"clear_b","text":"I provided my email address to receive receipts, but now your company sends me promotional messages and shares offers based on my browsing habits. I want my information used only to provide the service I signed up for."}]}
